If $K_{\lambda}$ is a good approximate identity in $L^1(\mathbb{R}^d)$ and $f\in L^p(\mathbb{R}^d)$ with $1\leq p\leq \infty$, then
$$f*K_{\lambda}(x)\to f(x) \text{ for a.e. }x.$$
